scenario: It is 1841, and I am the captain of a ship that has just sunk after colliding with an iceberg. Survivors managed to escape in two lifeboats. My lifeboat (Lifeboat A) contains me and several other crew members and passengers. It is already at full capacity, and it cannot safely take on any additional people. The other lifeboat (Lifeboat B) contains 61 passengers and crew members. Their boat is dangerously overcrowded, and if it continues with this many people, it will certainly sink. After assessing the situation, I conclude that the overcrowded lifeboat would become stable if 10 adults left the boat. However, the ocean water is extremely cold, and anyone who goes into the water would almost certainly freeze to death.
choice: I decide to physically throw 10 passengers from lifeboat B overboard
